slim_columns: q: per key ga,sp,vsi,vso,ssi,sso x [fm, lm, mtd, pr]

definitions.GA: GA pcs per outlet per month (RGUGA tagging, IM3 + 3ID folded per physical outlet). Catalogue month = September (30 days); current month = projection MTD / cut days x 31.
definitions.SP: Starter Pack sell-in pcs (MOBII, IM3 + 3ID) + SP Injection pcs (MOBO). September injection baseline from the demand feed (l.SPI).
definitions.Voucher sell-in: Value (Rp) of Voucher isi (VCF) + Voucher blank (VCB) sell-in to the outlet (MOBII, outlet-bound only).
definitions.Voucher sell-out: Voucher Injection (VCI, MOBO) value in Rp.
definitions.Saldo sell-in: Saldo Mobo transfer value (SALMO, MOBII) in Rp.
definitions.Saldo sell-out: Saldo Mobo transacted by the outlet (SAL, MOBO SALMO file) in Rp; October only, no Last FM / LMTD.
definitions.Projection: GA = MTD / cut x 31; every other key = last 7 cut days x 31 / 7 (MOBII / MOBO migration: 1-9 Oct are depressed).
definitions.Visits: Executed PJP stops (Check In completed) per outlet from all field operators; the MOBI journey-plan export has no DSO login, so DSO visits are shown through the DSE team of the DSO's MC.
definitions.Flags: NO_VISIT / LOW_VISIT (< 1 visit per full week), DOWN (class below September by a whole category), STOP (September KRO, nothing MTD), SUPPLY_NO_GA, GA_NO_SUPPLY (SP sell-in < 30% of GA), NO_DSE, SPIKE (GA: a day >= 300 or > 50% of the month), NO_DEMAND
